description.value:
When in a junk-rich environment, you can spend 4 hours to attempt a Crafting check to scavenge the materials you need to Craft a non-consumable item of 2nd level or lower. The GM determines the DC based on the level of the item you're attempting to Craft. During your daily preparations, you must perform some maintenance on this junk item or it falls apart and gains the broken condition. You can only have one junk item at a time. If you're an expert in Crafting, you can have two junk items at a time. If you're a master in Crafting, you can have four junk items at a time. If you're legendary in Crafting, you can have eight junk items at a time and can Craft junk items of an item level up to half your level.

Critical Success You locate suitable raw materials worth half the Price of the item you intend to Craft.

Success You locate raw materials worth one-quarter the Price of the item you intend to Craft.

Failure You fail to locate any raw materials.

Critical Failure Poor materials ruins 10 percent of the raw materials you use to Craft your item.
